issue.title: Stop artifact-link admission from reloading the full event snapshot on every publish
issue.description:
## Feature proposal

Stop artifact-link admission from reloading the full event snapshot on every
publish.

The 2026-11-27 10:33 apollo digest (plan
`plan:202611/artifact_link_job_budgets.md`) timed bob-cli's publication-pass
link drain at `publish=100.48s admission=39.29s beads=31.12s
aggregate=27.96s`. Admission loads the full event snapshot (about 11.4k event
files for bob-cli) whenever a deadline-bearing publish still has budget, so
one drain can spend ~40s before any new events are admitted. Closed bug
sase-1rt made `preview_aggregate` reuse one snapshot; publish admission still
rebuilds it.

## Why this is out of scope

`plan:202611/artifact_link_job_budgets.md` only adds a 60s publish headroom
gate and a bounded `artifact-link-events.lock` wait so admission cannot start
with too little budget. Caching or incrementally updating the snapshot is the
base-cost work that plan left as follow-up.
